label: Asymptotic-closure wedge
title: A two-axis closure wedge passes at width 12 and fails at width 14
summary: Rules 54/110 sit strictly between Rule 184 and Rule 30 in repair-depth and safe-forgetting density at fresh width 12. At width 14 Rule 110 ties Rule 184 in repair depth, failing the preregistered strict wedge; width 16 was not run.
takeaway: The two-axis geometry captures the intended finite-width contrast once, but pointwise repair-depth ordering is not robust across the next fresh width.
